addons.name: Insights
addons.summary: Session topics per project and a summary of your month by Claude
addons.description: Lists the sessions of Claude Code, OpenCode and Hermes under the titles the agents gave them themselves, per project, on each agent's details page. Summarize with Claude… writes a few paragraphs about what you mainly worked on in the last 30 days: after you saw and confirmed exactly what goes out, the titles and numbers (never your conversations) go to your own Claude Code.
reads: The titles Claude Code, OpenCode and Hermes gave their sessions themselves (Claude Code's ai-title lines in ~/.claude/projects; the title column of OpenCode's and Hermes's databases, read-only)
The session numbers Asterism already shows (projects, times, tokens)
sends: Only when you click Summarize with Claude… and confirm the preview: those titles and numbers, never the conversations, to your own Claude Code (claude -p in plan mode, no MCP servers, no saved session)
